get.summary: Read up to 25 recent unarchived local chat summaries
get.description: Read-only, newest activity first. Pass next_cursor unchanged with the same search to continue; null means exhausted, including when a nonfinal page is empty. Omit cursor to restart after changing search or if a cursor is rejected. Results are live, so concurrent activity can move chats between pages; clients should deduplicate IDs. Requires a loopback Host, no foreign Origin or cross-site request, and the local-client header. Responses are not cached. Only search and cursor query parameters are accepted, each at most once. The existing /api/chats array response remains available to the dashboard and older clients.

parameters.name: search
parameters.description: Title substring; omitted or empty means all titles.

parameters.name: cursor
parameters.description: Opaque Codex continuation cursor for the same search. Omitted or empty starts at the newest chat. Cursor lifetime follows the local Codex server.

200.description: A page and its continuation cursor

last_activity.description: Unix timestamp in seconds, or null when unknown.

503.description: Invalid query or unavailable Codex read, following the existing local read API. No queue changes occur. Retry transient failures with the same cursor; correct an invalid query or restart an invalid cursor.
